title: validate_workflow catches argument errors before the run
note: An inline task-only workflow with two declared int variables, so the 'declared variables' list in the message is this case's own. run.py cannot compare two steps' answers, so 'the same string validate_workflow returned' is asserted by pinning both messages whole in both steps: a rewording on the server fails both steps together and needs this file updated; one path drifting from the other fails one step.
